pages.title: From a Urine Compooper
pages.text: A Urine Compooper filled with filth will grow maggots after some time.$(br2)Right-click the compooper, or extract from the bottom, to obtain maggots.

pages.title: Plantable
pages.text: Maggots can be planted like seeds and grow into maggot crops.$(br2)They are a renewable filth crop and one of the basic ingredients for the fly system.

pages.title: Mature Drops
pages.text: A mature maggot crop drops 1-3 maggots and randomly drops one of the following:$(li)Sweet Berries$(li)Carrot$(li)Potato$(li)Beetroot Seeds
